mainEntity.name: How long does it typically take to build a backyard entertaining area?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for building a backyard entertaining area varies significantly based on the complexity and scope of the project. A simple patio or deck might take a few weeks, while a comprehensive outdoor kitchen with plumbing and electrical work could span several months. Factors such as material availability, weather conditions, and necessary permitting in cities like Alameda or Berkeley can also influence the schedule. We provide a detailed project timeline after the initial design and consultation phase.
